sources.title: Hypothetical comparison and n=k indicator arithmetic
sources.details: 80000-50000=30000;4/5=0.8;0.8-0.8=0. Exercise80000-60000=20000;3/5=0.6;0.6-0.8=-0.2. Criterion is smaller bytes AND at least same correct count on identical unskipped rows. Identical totals alone do not determine matching per-row success sets. For n=k, denominator C(k,k)=1. If c=0 numerator C(k,k)=1, value0. If c>0, k-c<k so numerator0, value1. Average indicator is sample-set oracle coverage, independent of majority-selection accuracy.
